summary: Frontend-only validation of the new 'Ventilation mensuelle' fiche and mid-year hire pro-rata feature. All 6 acceptance scenarios pass end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. Hire date was modified and restored to leave state clean.
critical_code_review_comments: BudgetFicheDialog.js line 233: 'pro-rata dès le mois {p.hire_month}' displays the raw month index from backend. Verify semantics — for hire 2026-07-15 it shows 'mois 7' which is correct (1-indexed July), just confirm this convention is consistent everywhere.
seed_data_creation: None. Employee #1 (Marie Bouchère) hire_date temporarily changed to 2026-07-15 then restored to 2018-06-01.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA (no react-router). Sidebar testids: nav-dashboard, nav-employes (NOT nav-employees), nav-budget, nav-hypotheses, nav-departements, nav-rapports, nav-journal, nav-utilisateurs. Login: fill email + type password + Enter.

verified_scenarios.2_fiche_ventilation_full_year_employee_1: 12 months = 13 773 $ each, fiche-total = 165 274 $ (= masse salariale année pleine). fiche-ventilation section renders below the fiche.
verified_scenarios.3_prorata_mid_year_hire_2026-07-15: Jan..Juin (fiche-month-0..5) = 0 $, Juil (fiche-month-6) = 7 553 $ (partial ~17/31 days), Août..Déc = 13 773 $ each. Badge in header: 'Embauche en cours d'année → pro-rata dès le mois 7 (6 mois)'. fiche-total = 76 417 $ < 165 274 $.
verified_scenarios.4_reduced_totals_and_row_badge: Row for Marie Bouchère shows Coût total = 76 417 $ and badge 'PRO-RATA 6 MOIS'. Budget total card dropped 709 488 $ → 620 631 $. Salaire de base card dropped 496 310 $ → 440 756 $.
verified_scenarios.5_dashboard_reflects_reduction: Dashboard comparatif-card: Salaires actuels 479 847 $ → 426 084 $, Budget CA 496 310 $ → 440 756 $, Revue 1/2 also 440 756 $. Masse salariale card 440 756 $, Budget global 620 631 $.
verified_scenarios.6_restore_2018-06-01: After restore, ventilation returns to 12 non-zero months of 13 773 $, fiche-total = 165 274 $, Budget total card back to 709 488 $. State clean.
